name: recoup-platform-plugin
description: Onboarding, health checks, and cross-cutting helpers for working with the Recoup platform from inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Onboarding and health checks for AI agents using the Recoup music platform
interface.longDescription: The Recoup platform plugin helps AI agents get started with Recoup's music business infrastructure. Includes guided onboarding (API validation, capability discovery, demo queries), health diagnostics, and cross-cutting helpers. Install this first, then add domain plugins (research, content, catalog diligence) based on your workflow.
